newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave CFO to resign.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave CFO to resign.

text.p: California Microwave Inc on Monday said Dennis Raney, an executive vice president and chief financial officer, planned to leave the company late February to take advantage of an opportunity in the computer industry.

The company, which supplies satellite earth stations and other communications systems, said Raney would continue to work as a consultant on the comprehensive review of its businesses announced on January 14.
When Raney steps down, George Spillane, vice president and secretary, will replace him as chief financial officer.
Spillane served as chief financial officer from November 1980 to April 1994 and from January 1996 to May 1996.
